-- intro: Painting Magic is a magic attribute that allows the user to generate and manipulate paint.
-- Description:
    This magic attribute allows the user to manifest a palette and a paintbrush which they use to generate and manipulate paint. Illustrations made with this paint can come to life. In order to use it to its full potential, specific spells are required, which are stored within grimoires. This magic is extremely versatile because of the paint's abilities to create anything the user imagines and to transform into any element, allowing the user to counter most magic attributes. A user's emotional state greatly affects their creativity and, by extension, their magic. Enjoyment and happiness can fuel their imagination, while frustration and anger can stifle it.
-- spell pages: Deux Tempêtes of Fire and Ice; Phantom Dragon Vouivre's Shout; Four-Headed Lindworm; Souterrain Giant's Strong Arm; Souterrain Groundswell; Sirène's Game; Master of Valhalla; God's Game; Souterrain Giant; Twilight of Valhalla; Spring of Restriction; Invasion of Heat-Infused Ice; Elemental Quintet
